services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: are held at the NDYC only on Saturdays. We offer two sets of times 1:30pm-3:30pm or 4:00pm-6:00pm. We can host up to 2 parties at the same time slot for a maximum of 4 parties per Saturday. $40.00 gets you two hours in one of our birthday party rooms (the Dance Studio or the Multipurpose Room) with access to the facility. -Must pay the $40.00 to secure the time slot which can be paid over the phone or in person.-NDYC is still open to the public during your party, but you get private access to one of our party rooms.-You can bring and set up your own decorations.-Up to 8 kids is included with the fee. If more than 8 kids show up, you can pay $5.00 extra per kid upon arrival.
